items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: INTERVIEWER: 'Well, thank Kevin. I can't call his name either...'

ctx.x: Same bunch. Such as? I mean. Oh, no. So, let me see now.

No, we had Reuben Oliver then. Reuben Oliver was playing. He was a banjo player. Banjo. Oh, man. That same big fellow on bass, I can't get his name. I can't call his name either. Well, thank Kevin. I can't call his name either, cause he was on the boat, but I don't know what it's up. And this boy, trombone player, played sax, one trombone player on one sax, we just call people's names. George, uh, one with the sax and one trombone player, they would sit up on the boat there a while, too. Talk about Nelson, Nelson…
Nelson, George Nelson George Nelson was saxophone player, George Nelson was saxophone player, and Nelson Jones was a trombone player.
